race.comment: SAY YOU WILL (14) looks promising and is set to return, with her winter campaign built around Listed races at Eagle Farm. She was an eye-catcher first-up last campaign when finishing quickly behind subsequent G1 winner The Next Episode, then was far from disgraced in the Listed Tattersalls Stakes & Oxlade Stakes. Two strong 1000m trials have her ready to go and Thompson sticking only increases confidence levels. MYSTICAL (12) is another handy filly set to return and also shoulders black type form. Has shown plenty of encouraging signs to date without putting a full race together. Has been fitted with a trial here and looks the main danger. WHITE SWAN (16) has clear improvement to come from a debut third at Eagle Farm after being slow away and held up. DEALS (2) is building nicely and should be at his top fourth-up. Worth some thought with the fitness edge. BOLD ENVOY (19) returns and looks best of the rest.
